name: Donna's Recipe
tabQuote: I built this in honor of my mama. Every bottle is a hug from her.
description: Plant-powered haircare for kinks, curls, coils, and the people who love them. Founded with love in honor of Tab's mother, Donna.

name: Tabitha Brown for Target
tabQuote: Target said yes to letting me put my whole heart in your kitchen and your closet. So I did.
description: Vegan pantry staples, kitchenware, home goods, and kids' fashion — all under $40. The collection that brought soft living to every aisle.

name: McLovin's Pet Food
hook: Bowls so good your dog will say grace.
tabQuote: My dog McLovin deserved better than mystery kibble. So we made better.
description: Plant-based, vet-formulated meals for dogs. Because they're family, and family eats good.

name: Cookbooks
hook: Recipes for the soul, the body, and the whole family.
tabQuote: Food is how I love. These books are how I share it.
description: Cooking from the Spirit · Feeding the Soul · I Am Tabitha Brown — bestsellers that taught a generation to season with love.

name: Tab Time
hook: Joy, kindness, and a little vegan snack.
tabQuote: Babies deserve TV that tells them they're already enough. That's what Tab Time is.
description: Live-action children's series streaming on Apple TV+ and YouTube Kids. Songs, crafts, and a whole lot of love.

name: Lil Tab Time
hook: For the babies and the babies-at-heart.
tabQuote: Soft, sweet, and made to be passed down. Like everything I love.
description: Kids' fashion and accessories — extending the Tab Time universe into closets everywhere.

name: The Tab Time Podcast
tabQuote: I wanted somewhere to talk to you for longer than 60 seconds. So I made one.
description: Weekly conversations on faith, food, family, and the work of becoming. Wherever you get podcasts.

name: Acting & Film
hook: The work that started it all.
tabQuote: I came to LA to act. Everything else is what God did with that.
description: The Chi · Will Trent · Showtime · Apple TV+. A growing body of work in front of the camera.

name: Speaking & Appearances
tabQuote: Wherever I go, I bring all of me. The South, the joy, the truth, the laugh.
description: Keynotes, panels, hosting, brand activations — for the rooms that need a little more love in them.
